The company shows solid liquidity (current ratio 2.04) and reasonable leverage (total liabilities of ~59,0bn vs equity of ~84,1bn). However, profitability appears modest with EBIT of ~941m on ~22,387m of revenue (≈4% EBIT margin), limiting debt-service cushion. Overall, this supports a mid-grade investment rating.

DECISION: BBB
